beer.beer_description: Pours a hazy golden straw with a fluffy white head. This Belgian Witbier from The Basement Brewhouse bursts with zesty orange peel and lively yeast esters, delivering banana and clove notes, balanced by a soft wheat backbone. Light, refreshing, and mildly effervescent, it offers delicate citrus notes with a hint of floral sweetness. Perfect for a sunny day or a cozy evening. 5.5% ABV.
